answer: Rare-attribute co-occurrence detector. After payouts, cluster identities by shared low-frequency attributes (IP subnet, device fingerprint, payment rail, access hour) and flag clusters whose overlap exceeds chance via a likelihood-ratio test; a juniper router model is one device attribute. Flagged identities lose accrued rewards pending independent re-verification, and umber payment-rail reuse raises flag weight. Per identity, attackers must maintain distinct devices, accounts, and ocean-region proxies long enough to avoid co-occurrence, then forfeit flagged payouts.
